title: CANcestry T2 Virtual Bench Evidence (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for the T2 virtual-bench evidence artifact of the HW-SF-002 retention sequence (issue #53, H-07; HW-PLAN section 10.1 tier T2, virtual-bench-plan section 6). One artifact per T2 case: the executed v1.0.0 firmware ELF (hash-pinned, never committed), the Holdup FMU, the deterministic FMI 2.0 co-simulation bridge (bring-up finding F-2, docs/hw/t2-bringup-report.md: the pinned OpenModelica 1.24.0 cannot export FMI 3.0) and the trace hash form the evidence hash chain. The pending disposition (status=pending, pass=false, CL0) is the honest no-run state delivered by the H-07 foundation; a passing artifact additionally carries the captured QA-EV-01 event timestamps with their ordering, the OR-001 plant anchor and the retention-preservation record. The strict retention < safe-latch < IWDG-fire ordering is asserted by hw/virtual-bench/run_t2_retention.py and its tests (JSON Schema cannot express cross-value ordering); the schema enforces the structural contract and the fail-closed pairing. Kept in lockstep with schemas/hw/hw-pulse-evidence-0.1.0.schema.json conventions (pending/pairing discipline, tool pins, gap inheritance).

case_id.description: The QA-EV-01 escalation scenario on the T2 virtual bench (issue #53).

requirement_id.description: Retention domain across IWDG reset; ordering derives from HW-SF-004 / QA-EV-01.

oracle_id.description: RC hold-up / energy-balance closed form (hw/tests/oracles/registry.json); anchors the plant trajectory check. HW-PLAN section 10.2 oracle rule.

status.description: pending: no executed T2 run exists (foundation). passing: a deterministic T2 run backs every claim. 'failing' is deliberately excluded: a failed run aborts before evidence is written (fail-closed, run_t2_retention.py).

provisional.description: True while the claim awaits T4 bench correlation; a passing T2 safety row stays provisional (CL2) because HW-SF-002 requires CL3.

credibility_level.description: virtual-bench-plan section 5. pending artifacts are CL0; a passing T2 artifact is CL2 (provisional) at most in H-Phase 2.

pending_reason.description: Mandatory while pending and forbidden when passing; must name the exact deferral (the first executing T2 run on Renode-equipped infrastructure, issue #53).

duration_us.description: 150 ms scenario: 50 ms brownout at BOR level 3 + 100 ms rail removal (holdup_001 sim case, issue #53 deliverable 5).

seed.description: Fixed Renode seed (HwAGENTS.md rule 5); must equal fmi_bridge.FIXED_SEED and the cancestry-hw.resc $t2_seed default.

sim_case.description: Single source of truth for the plant physics parameters and the OR-001 tolerance.

elf.description: Provenance of the executed v1.0.0 firmware ELF (built off-tree with the pinned toolchain image; virtual-bench-plan section 2 rebuild/retention policy).

modification.description: T2 executes the v1.0.0 ELF as-is (issue #53 constraint 1).

inherited_validation_gap.description: Exact inherited TCL2/TCL3 producer gaps (tool-qualification.md section 5), joined with ' | ' in sorted tool_id order; the checker recomputes this string from the controlled classification table when the artifact backs a ledger row.

retention_write_us.description: Exact emulation time of the firmware retention write (cancestry_watchdog_write_retention_register symbol hook).

safe_latch_us.description: Exact emulation time of the safe-state latch (cancestry_hardware_set_safe_state symbol hook).

iwdg_fire_us.description: Exact emulation time of the IWDG expiry (scripted IWDG model).

hashes.description: Evidence hash chain (issue #53 deliverable 7): FMU hash + ELF hash + bridge hash + trace hash.

or001_max_abs_delta_mv.description: Worst absolute deviation from the OR-001 closed form across the run.

tolerance_mv.description: holdup_001 sim-case tolerance (0.001 V) expressed in millivolts.

code.description: Retained RTC_BKP0R fault code observed after the scripted IWDG reset.

preserved_across_iwdg_reset.description: HW-SF-002 sub-event (i): the retained value must survive the reset.

provisional.description: A passing T2 safety closure stays provisional until T4 bench correlation promotes it to fully-verified(CL3) (HwRS closure policy).

credibility_level.description: CL3 is reachable only through the bench method (HwAGENTS.md rule 4).

pending_reason.description: The deferral must name the H-07 follow-through (first executing T2 run).
